Conference in Geneva to recognise 1971 genocide in Bangladesh
2021-09-23T13:44:48+06:00 | Ansar Ahmed Ullah
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/conference-geneva-recognise-1971-genocide-bangladesh-2182451

Europe-based diaspora organisation, European Bangladesh Forum (EBF), in collaboration with Switzerland Human Rights Commission Bangladesh, will hold an international conference titled "Recognition of 1971 Bangladesh Genocide" at the Geneva Press Club in Switzerland on September 30.

The same day, EBF will hold a demonstration in front of the Broken Chair sculpture near the United Nations headquarters in Geneva. A documentary film titled "War Crimes 1971" will also be screened at the conference.

The conference will be addressed, among others, by Member of the European Parliament, Brando Benifei; Member of the British Parliament from the Labour Party, Rushanara Ali; former member of the Dutch Parliament, Harry van Bommel; Professor of Vrije University Amsterdam, Dr Anthonie Holslag; Dutch journalist of de Volkskrant, Rob Vreeken; Trustee of International Crimes Strategy Forum (ICSF), Dr Rayhan Rashid; and son of martyred intellectual Prof Munier Chowdhury, Asif Munier, from Bangladesh.

The conference will also be addressed by the Director of Switzerland Human Rights Commission Bangladesh, Khalilur Rahman, and EBF Netherlands President Bikash Chowdhury, while Dr Mojibur Doftori, a writer and senior researcher from Finland, will chair the conference.

Both the demonstration and the conference will be aired live by Ekattor Television and Somoy Television. The British Bangla News will broadcast it live in the UK.
